_doc: Scene 2 'reuses the platform' for the admin dashboard mock. t = scene seconds after the user presses Confirm in @brimos_demo_bot (scene 2 script).
Same format as scene1.timeline.json. The architect finds the catalog module tg-channels and the platform service tg-reader, so 2 tasks instead of 3 and ~4 minutes instead of 10.
At the end the ranking code goes back to the catalog as a new module tg-post-ranking 0.1.0 ('the platform learns').
bot_stages mirror script2.yaml progress (240 s, stages end at 17/56/71/85/100 %, equal speeds). The bot adds random jitter, so boundaries drift by ~5-10 s per take.

story.title: Weekly digest of competitors' Telegram channels
story.request: I need a bot that sends me a weekly summary of what my competitors post in their Telegram channels
story.description:
Competitor digest bot
- Channels: @northroast, @beanbox_daily, @kaffa_lab
- In the summary: top 5 posts per channel by views, posts that took off are flagged
- Delivery: Mondays at 9:00, covering the past 7 days
- Channels list: /add and /remove
story.acceptance_criteria:
1. The digest covers the posts of the past 7 days of every watched channel
2. Each channel shows its top 5 posts by views
3. A post whose views are 3x the channel's weekly median is flagged
4. The digest arrives on Monday at 9:00 in the user's time zone
5. /add and /remove change the list of channels
6. Each item shows the channel, a one-line excerpt, the views and a link
requirement_list: Watch @northroast, @beanbox_daily and @kaffa_lab; /add and /remove change the list
Collect every post of the past 7 days with its views
Rank each channel's posts by views and keep the top 5
Flag a post as "took off" when its views are 3× the channel's weekly median
Send the digest on Mondays at 9:00 in the user's time zone
Each item: channel, one-line excerpt, views and a link to the post
